messages:
Aisha (CS Ops): Heads up — we're seeing a ~18% uptick in 'renewal risk' playbook triggers this morning. looks correlated with accounts missing MRR and onboarding_stage=null. 
Max (CS): saw that. a lot of small accounts hitting the alert. could be a bad import? :thinking_face:
Raj (Data): can you paste one example account id? i'll run a quick check across the last 90 days.
Aisha (CS Ops):  acct_00421 is one. export attached to the thread (csv). not sure who owned that import.
Emily (CSM): I think these are trial->paid migrations where billing info didn't sync. we had a webhook failure last month but thought it was fixed.
Raj (Data): quick SQL to find similar rows: 
```sql
SELECT account_id, plan, mrr, onboarding_stage, created_at
FROM crm.accounts
WHERE mrr IS NULL OR onboarding_stage IS NULL
  AND created_at > now() - interval '90 days'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
Raj (Data): I'll run that and share counts.
harry-bot: Automated alert: playbook:renewal-risk triggered 42 times in the last 6h.
Max (CS): If these are false positives we should lower the weight of the 'has_mrr' feature in health scoring until the backfill runs.
Aisha (CS Ops): agree. current scoring weights: usage=0.4, support_tickets=0.2, mrr=0.3, onboarding=0.1. we can test mrr=0.15, onboarding=0.05 and bump usage.
Raj (Data): I can produce a simulated recalculation quickly. will baseline current score distribution and then apply new weights to see change in risk bucket counts.
Emily (CSM): also we should add a playbook guard: require at least 14 days since created_at for renewal nudge on accounts with null mrr. reduces noisy hits on fresh signups.
Max (CS): good call. simplest patch to playbook rule: add condition `created_at < now() - interval '14 days'`
Aisha (CS Ops): action items: 1) Raj run SQL and simulation (ETA 90m) 2) Max deploy temporary playbook guard (ETA 2h) 3) Data/ops coordinate backfill for missing mrr (ETA EOD) — assign owners?
Raj (Data): taking #1. will post counts + a CSV of affected account_ids.
Max (CS): I'll do #2, will push config change to staging then prod. tagging @ops for release window.
Emily (CSM): I'll own outreach for the top 15 ARR accounts affected.
Aisha (CS Ops): tagging the followup doc: https://notion.redwood.com/csops/score-feature-audit (please add notes).
Raj (Data): results: 184 accounts in last 90d. breakdown attached. with the suggested weight change, renewal-risk bucket goes from 64 -> 19 (approx).
Max (CS): nice. pushing guard now. staging test passed. deploying to prod in 10. :rocket:
harry-bot: Deployment notice: playbook-service v2.14.3 promoted to prod by Max (CS).
Aisha (CS Ops): great. once backfill is scheduled we'll revert weight changes and monitor. leaving this thread open for status updates.
Emily (CSM): quick note — logging a support ticket for the billing webhook team so we can prevent recurrence.
Max (CS): prod done. monitoring risk alerts.
Raj (Data): created a one-off backfill job: `scripts/backfill_mrr_from_billing.sh --since 2025-01-01`. queued for EOD run.
Aisha (CS Ops): perfect. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
